label: Fed reaches zero bound
significance: Fed establishes a 0–0.25% federal funds target range during the financial crisis.

label: Post-crisis lift-off
significance: Fed raises the target range to 0.25–0.50% as policy normalization begins.

label: After emergency COVID cut
significance: Monday curve after the Sunday March 15 emergency cut to 0–0.25% and announcement of Treasury and MBS purchases.
observationNote: Event was Sunday March 15; chart uses the next observed business day, Monday March 16. Verify this exact observation exists before enabling.

label: Inflation hiking cycle begins
significance: Fed raises the target range to 0.25–0.50% and signals ongoing increases.

label: 75bp inflation hike
significance: Fed raises the target range to 1.50–1.75% as inflation remains elevated.

label: Rates reach 5.25–5.50%
significance: Fed raises the target range to 5.25–5.50%, a useful high-rate-cycle comparison.

label: 50bp easing step
significance: Fed cuts the target range by 50 basis points to 4.75–5.00% as inflation makes further progress.
